name: Loyalty
overview: Scripture emphasizes loyalty as a vital principle, demonstrated by obedience and steadfast commitment to God, leaders, and community. The Israelites' pledge to follow Joshua wherever he led (Joshua 1:16) and Ruth's devotion to Naomi, adopting her people and God as her own (Ruth 1:16), exemplify personal and communal loyalty. The law enforces loyalty through respect for rulers and adherence to God's commands, warning of swift judgment for disobedience (Exodus 22:28; Ezra 7:26). Additionally, honoring leaders fosters obedience among the people, as seen in the instruction to place honor upon those appointed to lead (Numbers 27:20; Ezra 6:10).
